question: The angle of elevation of the top of a tower from a point 63 m distance away from its foot is 30°. Find the height (in m) of the tower.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a right triangle with an angle of elevation θ, tanθ = opposite ÷ adjacent.

Here, tan30° = height ÷ distance ⇒ height = distance × tan30°.

tan30° = 1 ÷ √3 ⇒ height = 63 × (1 ÷ √3) = 21√3.

**∴ Answer = 21√3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Angle of elevation = 30°
